sign_desc: # briefnr 1069 (Willem van Hessen to Willem van Oranje, 23 Mar 1563, KHAG B 12,6 "origineel"), interlinear decipherment
# in a contemporary hand above the cipher, siblings/01069_p2.png (and p3, p4), line 1 of p2 only, read this pass.
# 'sign_desc' is a plain-language description of the hand-drawn glyph (not a Unicode transcription -- the system
# is not in Unicode); see the image_ref crop for the actual shape. grade H = the gloss letter above the sign is
# clearly and unambiguously written; M = gloss legible but the letter identification (or the underlying word
# reading, e.g. m/n, b/p confusion) is uncertain. Word read as a whole: "...mit Gr(u/m)(n/mb)ach(s)" -- matches
# Wilhelm von Grumbach, the outlawed knight at the center of the Grumbach Feud/siege of Gotha, the same affair
# mentioned in the target's own WVO Inhoud field for 1127 (28 Jan 1567) -- consistent political context between
# the sibling and the target, three-plus years apart.
